releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.189: Private Locker writing-only, encrypted search/editing, four-digit Diary-style PIN, Pattern, Favourite Name recovery and separate Android Keystore fingerprint. Diary Lock remains unchanged.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 296: When Private Locker Lock is OFF, show a separate Locker Security gate with Lock On Karein and Locker Kholein. Lock On is outside the writing/search area and restores the PIN gate; Locker Kholein keeps Lock OFF access available. Saved encrypted writing and PIN/recovery data, Diary Lock and Note Lock are unchanged.
